title.narrative: Preparatory Support (pre core) to National Association of Librarians 2021 - (New Strategy Code) Repayment Pre-core National Association of Librarians 2021
Preparatory Support (pre core) to National Association of Librarians 2021

description.narrative:
Det förberedande kärnstödet för enskilda organisationer bereds som en förenklad insats. Syftet med det förberedande kärnstödet är att stärka organisationens kapacitet och utveckla deras interna regelverk.
Nationalföreningen för bibliotekarier (National Association of Librarians) kommer under denna första fas av stödet (innan kärnstöd) att genomföra de prioriterade rekommendationerna från `Swedish Development Advisors` presenterade i den systembaserade revisionsrapporten som gjordes 2020. `National Association of Librarians` utvecklar institutionell kapacitet, interna rutiner, personalkunskaper och andra färdigheter för att kunna genomföra kärnstödsaktiviteter. Baserat på en kommande uppföljningsrapport som avser aktiviteter under denna första fas (rapport tas preliminärt fram i december 2021) kan Sida sedan överväga att fortsätta med kärnstöd till `Women`s Initiatives` baserat på en strategisk plan, resultatram och den strategiska budgeten som utvecklats inför kärnstödet.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 282 000 SEK.

The pre-core support granted for the organization is a simplified contribution which aims at supporting the organization to develop its internal capacities and policies.
During pre-core support phase National Association of Librarians will implement priority recommendations provided by the Swedish Development Advisors in the system-based audit report produced in 2020. Therefore, it will develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills to be able to implement core-support activities. Based on a follow-up report on pre-core activities to be conducted tentatively in December 2021, Sida may consider continuing with core-support with National Association of Librarians based on the Strategic Plan, RAF and strategic budget developed during pre-core support.
The interventions' total budget is 282 000 SEK.

The main purpose of the support: to strengthen the organization by providing support in developing and implementing several important policies for good governance within the team, the planned development of the organization, the promotion and financial management so that the organization can develop sustainably over a long period of time. Within the framework of this support, the Association`s team, with the support of the Swedish Embassy, will direct its efforts towards the implementation of the main recommendations.
